# Jarvis AntiVPN

### The anti-VPN that **WON'T** block your real players.

A **lightweight Velocity & BungeeCord proxy plugin** backed by a real-time cloud detection network. It blocks VPNs, anonymous proxies, datacenter IPs, Tor and known evasion-network nodes across your whole network — without punishing your legitimate players on mobile data, CGNAT or their home connection.

> **Free in early access.** Detection runs in the JarvisGuard backend; the plugin is a thin, fault-tolerant client. Works on any Velocity or BungeeCord proxy — just paste your license key.

---

## Why Jarvis?

The #1 pain of any anti-VPN isn't letting a cheater slip through — it's **wrongly banning a legitimate player**. Someone on mobile data, behind CGNAT or behind their home router is NOT an attacker, yet most cheap plugins kick them anyway.

Jarvis is built the other way around: **when in doubt, the player GETS IN.**

- 🛡️ **One block protects your whole network — instantly.** When Jarvis blocks an IP, that signed verdict propagates to **all** your connected proxies in real time over SSE. No restart, no waiting for a list to refresh.
- 🎯 **Minimal false positives by design.** CGNAT-, mobile- and home-network-aware, so your real community sails in.
- 🕵️ **Detects what cheap plugins don't.** It looks at the connection's behaviour and known evasion patterns, not just a stale datacenter IP list.
- ⚡ **Lightweight & fault-tolerant.** All the heavy logic lives in the backend; the plugin caches locally, applies a signed verdict, and keeps your server running even if the backend has an incident.
- 🌍 **Multi-language panel.** Fully translated (Spanish, English, German, French, Polish, Russian, Turkish), with LATAM-focused support.

---

## What others DON'T see

Most cheap anti-VPNs just query a datacenter IP list. Jarvis weighs the connection's **behaviour**, not just an IP, so it catches what a plain lookup misses:

- 🛰️ **VPNs, anonymous proxies and datacenter IPs** — from live threat feeds kept current, not a stale cached list.
- 🧅 **Tor and known evasion-network nodes.**
- 🔁 **Ban evaders** — surfaced for your staff.
- 👥 **Bot waves** — dampened before they hit your lobby.
- 🏠 **Legitimate home and mobile connections** — recognised so they are NOT penalised (fewer false positives).

---

## 🌐 Real-time network protection

When Jarvis blocks an IP on **any** server of your network, that block propagates **in real time** to **ALL** connected proxies. An attacker who hits one server is blocked everywhere else before they reach your door — one verdict, applied instantly across your whole network. You're not relying on a static list; you're protected by live intelligence.

---

## 🛡️ Account Shield

Built-in **account-theft protection** — a layer almost no anti-VPN offers. It flags signs that an account may be compromised and lists them in the panel for your staff, who can act in **one click**. It protects your players and staff, not just blocks VPNs.

---

## ⚡ Real time (SSE)

Global blocks and panel actions (whitelist, kick, broadcast messages) reach your proxies **instantly** over SSE and invalidate the local cache. What you decide in the panel applies right away — no restarts.

---

## 🚀 How to start (4 steps)

1. **Register free** at [jarvisguard.com](https://jarvisguard.com) and copy your **license key** (everything unlocked, no card).
2. **Drop the JAR** into your proxy's `plugins/` folder (Velocity or BungeeCord) and start it once to generate the config.
3. **Paste your key** in `plugins/jarvis/config.yml`:
   ```yaml
   key: "YOUR-LICENSE-KEY"
   ```
   (or set it live with `/antivpn key <key>`). The backend URL and shared secret are fetched automatically.
4. **Done.** Your network is protected instantly. Manage everything from the panel.

### Commands & permissions

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/antivpn key <key>` | Set the license key without restarting |
| `/antivpn stats` | Backend connection status and local cache stats |
| `/antivpn reload` | Reload config, clear cache and resync blocks |

Permissions: `jarvis.command` (use the command), `jarvis.admin` (subcommands + detection notifications), `jarvis.bypass` (never checked — for trusted staff).

---

## 🔒 Privacy & data (network disclosure)

> **This plugin communicates with an external service.** By design, it sends the incoming connection data (such as the IP and UUID) to the JarvisGuard backend, which returns a signed verdict. This is **required** for the anti-VPN to work. It needs an internet connection and a free license key from [jarvisguard.com](https://jarvisguard.com). It is **not an anticheat** — it does not analyse gameplay or game mechanics. If the backend has an incident, your server keeps running normally and protection resumes automatically; the behaviour during incidents is configurable.

The plugin is **closed-source** (All Rights Reserved) and **not obfuscated**, to make platform scanning easy.

Full details: [Privacy Policy](https://jarvisguard.com/legal/privacy) · [Terms](https://jarvisguard.com/legal/terms).

---

## ❓ FAQ

**Will it block my legitimate players?**
That's not the goal — the opposite. When in doubt, the player gets in. Legitimate connections (including mobile and home networks) sail through. Minimizing false positives is the core principle.

**Does it work on Spigot/Bukkit?**
It runs on your **proxy** — **Velocity and BungeeCord**. One filter on the proxy protects your whole network. It's not a per-backend Bukkit/Spigot plugin.

**What if your backend goes down — does my server go down?**
No. The plugin is fault-tolerant: your server stays open, already-known blocks stay blocked via the local cache, and protection resumes automatically. You choose the behaviour during incidents.

**Bedrock / Floodgate?**
Fully supported — Jarvis is tuned to protect your Bedrock and console players without false positives.

**Does it cost anything?**
Not in early access: everything unlocked for free, no card. Paid plans will come later; your server stays protected through the transition.
